description: Liminal analysis engine — input/output schema for the two-layer analysis pipeline

card.$ref: See tarot_card_schema.md for full card object structure

input_schema.raw_transcript: string — verbatim ASR output, preserving fillers, self-corrections, and pause markers e.g. [pause 2.1s]

features.first_person_density: float — count of I/me/my/myself / total word count
features.self_corrections: list[string] — correction phrases detected e.g. ['I mean', 'no wait', 'actually']
features.speaking_duration_seconds: float or null — from audio metadata if available

analysis_layer_output.description: Structured analytical output — NOT shown directly to user. Input to writing layer.

deviation_signals.description: Dimensions where user's language deviates significantly from card's theme_space (delta >= 0.3)

item_schema.interpretation: string — one sentence on what this deviation suggests psychologically
item_schema.evidence: list[string] — direct quotes or features from transcript supporting this

active_archetypes.description: Jungian archetypes activated by the user's language, matched against card's jungian_mapping.complex_signals

item_schema.evidence: list[string] — direct quotes or pattern descriptions from transcript
item_schema.jungian_ref: string — brief reference to Jungian concept, grounded in public domain texts

complex_indicators.description: Potential complex activity — patterns suggesting an emotionally charged unconscious content

item_schema.raw_evidence: string — exact quote or feature value

shadow_hints.description: What the card's shadow_aspect suggests about what may be avoided or projected
shadow_hints.note: These are hypotheses to be offered with uncertainty, not diagnoses

mirrored_phrases.description: User's own words that will be quoted back in the writing layer — the anti-Barnum mechanism
mirrored_phrases.selection_criteria: Emotionally loaded phrases, repeated words, self-corrections, absolutist language

analysis_layer_output.weak_signal_flag: boolean — true if transcript < 50 words, or features show minimal distinctiveness
analysis_layer_output.weak_signal_reason: string or null — e.g. 'transcript too short', 'language closely mirrors card themes with no deviation'

writing_layer_input.description: The writing layer receives the full analysis_layer_output plus the original card and transcript

writing_layer_output.description: Final text shown to user. Two parts displayed in sequence.

part_1_jungian_reading.label: What your words reveal
required_elements: At least 2 direct quotes of user's own phrases (the mirrored_phrases list)
Reference to the most significant deviation_signal if delta >= 0.3
Active archetype named and briefly explained (non-jargon)
If shadow_hints are relevant: raised as a question, not a statement
If weak_signal_flag is true: honest acknowledgment that signal is thin
tone_constraints: Therapist register: warm, direct, not sentimental
No AI clichés: avoid 'It seems', 'It appears', 'delve', 'navigate', 'tapestry'
No metaphor stacking — one metaphor maximum per reading
Uncertainty expressed as uncertainty: 'this might point to...' not 'this reveals that you...'

part_2_card_meaning.label: The card itself
required_elements: Standard upright meaning of the card
One sentence connecting the card's core theme to what emerged in part_1
Reversed meaning offered briefly if contextually relevant
tone_constraints: More neutral than part_1 — this is reference, not interpretation
Do not repeat phrases from part_1

pipeline_notes.layer_separation: analysis_layer_output must be generated before writing_layer_output. Never merge into a single prompt.
pipeline_notes.no_fabrication: analysis layer must not invent Jungian quotes or attribute specific passages to texts unless the passage is from public domain works (pre-1928 English translations)
pipeline_notes.ordering_rationale: Part 1 (Jungian reading) displayed before Part 2 (standard meaning) to prevent anchoring bias — user sees their projection analysis before the 'answer'
